section divider: DATA LOADING AND PREPARATION

spans.operation: load the full player-referee dyad CSV as the study population with no upfront filtering
average the two independent raters' scores into one continuous skin-tone measure
collapse red-card count into a binary any-red-card outcome (redCards>0)

spans.note: computes and prints inter-rater correlation/agreement diagnostics, not used downstream
section divider: DEFINE SKIN TONE GROUPS

spans.operation: dichotomize skin tone into light (<=0.25) vs dark (>=0.5), dropping the middle band entirely, then encode the retained groups as a 0/1 dark indicator

spans.note: section divider: PREPARE MODELING DATASET

spans.operation: choose which columns (outcome, group, covariates, ID fields) enter the modeling dataset
restrict to complete cases on the selected variables, dropping any dyad with a missing value
one-hot encode position and leagueCountry, keeping every level at creation time (drop_first=False)

spans.note: section divider: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
tabulates dark vs light counts, red-card counts, and unadjusted rates purely for console reporting
section divider: FIT LOGISTIC REGRESSION MODEL

spans.operation: assemble the regression design matrix: dark indicator plus continuous covariates plus dummy sets with one reference level per category dropped via [1:], and add an intercept column
fit a logistic regression of anyRedCard on the design matrix using cluster-robust standard errors clustered by player

spans.note: reports raw coefficient, clustered SE, z, p-value, CI and odds ratio for the dark term
section divider: CALCULATE ADJUSTED RISK DIFFERENCE (G-COMPUTATION)

spans.operation: estimate the g-computation adjusted risk difference by scoring the whole sample under counterfactual dark=1 and dark=0 and differencing the mean predicted probabilities

spans.note: section divider: INFERENCE: PARAMETRIC SIMULATION

spans.operation: propagate parameter uncertainty by drawing 10,000 coefficient vectors from the fitted model's asymptotic multivariate-normal distribution and recomputing the risk difference for every draw
summarize the simulated risk-difference draws as a 2.5/97.5 percentile interval and derive a two-sided p-value from the share of draws on each side of zero

spans.note: section divider: VISUALIZATION
histogram of simulated risk differences with reference lines for point estimate, CI, and null
writes the figure to disk

prints primary estimand: adjusted risk difference, CI, p-value
